records.subject: Picking back up with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Sometimes the hardest part is just the first project. If you'd like, send me a rough list of what your team's working on and I'll help set it up myself.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for setting up Orchard Group on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no reply to the only outreach [email:0a7f4522], no project, no invite, no tickets. No engagement signal at all, and all three stall reasons are active with 8 days left, so unaided self-activation is unlikely though not impossible on a Starter plan.

draft.subject: Getting your first project started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Following up on my note from last week about getting Orchard Group going in Wrenfield. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the best place to start. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
